## How Hola Works

### Technology Overview

#### Peer-to-Peer Network Architecture
Hola's free service uses a unique peer-to-peer (P2P) network model:
1. Free users share a small portion of their idle bandwidth with the network
2. This creates a distributed network of IPs across 195 countries
3. When you connect to a country, you route through peers in that location
4. The P2P model enables true global coverage without massive server infrastructure

#### Premium Server Architecture
Premium users get:
- Dedicated, non-P2P servers
- Faster, more reliable connections
- Priority routing
- No bandwidth sharing requirement

### Connection Types by Product

| Product | Native App | Technology | Encryption |
|---------|------------|------------|------------|
| Chrome Extension | Yes | Proxy Routing | Split tunneling (partial) |
| Edge Extension | Yes | Proxy Routing | Split tunneling (partial) |
| Opera Extension | Yes | Proxy Routing | Split tunneling (partial) |
| Windows App | Yes | Full VPN | Yes (full) |
| macOS App | Yes | Full VPN | Yes (full) |
| iOS App | Yes | Full VPN | Yes (full) |
| Android App | Yes | Proxy Routing | Split tunneling (partial) |
| Apple TV App | Yes | Full VPN | Yes (full) |
| Fire TV App | Yes | Proxy Routing | Split tunneling (partial) |
| Android TV | Yes | Proxy Routing | Split tunneling (partial) |
| Smart TV DNS | No | Smart DNS | No |
| Roku | No | DNS Config | No |

**Encryption Explained:**
- **Full encryption:** All traffic is encrypted through VPN tunnel (Windows, macOS, iOS, Apple TV)
- **Split tunneling (partial):** Traffic is divided; some passes through encrypted tunnel, some does not (browser extensions, Android, Fire TV)
- **No encryption:** Location change only via DNS (Smart TV manual setup, Roku)

1. **Download:** Visit hola.org/download or app store for your device
